description: Find things worth photographing by name instead of by OpenStreetMap tag, with automatic failover across Overpass mirrors.

novel_features.name: Find photographic subjects near a place
novel_features.description: Finds things worth photographing near a place — water towers, lighthouses, brutalist buildings, piers, viewpoints — by name rather than by OpenStreetMap tag.

novel_features.name: Browse the subject taxonomy
novel_features.description: Lists every subject type the CLI knows how to find, with the OpenStreetMap tags behind each one.

novel_features.name: Subjects along a drive
novel_features.description: Finds subjects inside a corridor between two places, so a drive can be planned around what is worth stopping for.

novel_features.name: Export to GeoJSON
novel_features.description: Writes results as GeoJSON for opening in a map, a Leaflet page, or any GIS tool.

novel_features.name: Mirror health
novel_features.description: Shows which Overpass mirrors are currently answering and how many rate-limit slots each has free.
